name: Potluck table
summary: A table of plates showing who brings what, what's missing and what's doubled up.
useWhen: a potluck or holiday dinner where people bring dishes
'who's bringing what for thanksgiving', 'we have 3 pies', 'someone get drinks'
dontUseWhen: a shopping list for one person (use grocery)
splitting what the food cost (use a bill split)

host.description: The centerpiece line, e.g. "Dad's turkey", or empty

need.description: What this plate is for: 'dessert', 'veggies', or '' for an open spot

who.description: Who is bringing it, or empty

defaults.description: Dish to bring for a need when someone moves onto it, e.g. { veggies: 'green beans' }

to.description: The need to move them to
